title: Coach messaging authors without creating or replacing their prose

verify.note: Actual server action and generator execute with inert permission, provider and storage dependencies; unauthorized calls deny, generated prose is rejected and no draft is created. Focused DOM tests separately verify typed replies and setup answers remain unchanged. Local proof; deployment and production acceptance are separate.

detail: Guided campaign and sequence assistance returns questions, checks and a proposed outcome measurement. Only explicit manual continuation creates an author-controlled draft; model failure has no write fallback. Shared CRM reply assistance returns coaching in a separate region and never fills the reply composer. Manual sends, summaries and triage retain their existing gates. No schema or provider configuration changes.
